title: A local cluster for study: minikube, kind and k3d

videos.script: Every lesson from here on types commands at a cluster. This lesson builds the one you will type them at. {{build}} It does not need a cloud account, and it does not need a second computer. Three free tools build a real cluster on the machine you already have: minikube, kind and k3d. {{three}} This course recommends kind, and records everything with it. Its nodes are Docker containers, so a cluster of three nodes starts in under a minute and costs less than a gigabyte of memory. {{kind}} You will build one, look at what it is made of, and measure what it costs. {{measure}} Then you will break it four times, on purpose. Those four errors are the ones that stop most people on the first day, and each has a one-line fix. {{break}}
